# Japan Wire by Kyodo News

> Japan Wire delivers comprehensive English-language coverage of Japan's domestic news, international relations, culture, and business developments through Kyodo News' authoritative reporting.

Japan Wire is the English-language news platform of Kyodo News, Japan's leading news agency. It provides breaking news, in-depth analysis, and cultural features covering Japan's role in global affairs, particularly US-Japan relations, Indo-Pacific strategy, and Japanese society.

## Key Topics

- Japan news
- Kyodo News
- Japan-US relations
- Breaking news
- International relations
- Iran conflict
- Indo-Pacific
- Trump administration
- Business projects
- Daily digest
- Japanese culture
- Asia-Pacific
- Tokyo
- World news
- Election coverage

## Core News & Updates

- [Japan Wire Homepage](https://english.kyodonews.net): Homepage for Japan Wire, Kyodo News' online publication on Japan news
- [Latest All Stories](https://english.kyodonews.net/list/news): All latest news stories aggregated from Kyodo News about Japan
- [Japan Domestic News](https://english.kyodonews.net/list/news/japan): Japan domestic news section with daily digest of breaking stories
- [World News](https://english.kyodonews.net/list/news/world): International news stories where Japan plays a key role globally
- [Election Coverage](https://english.kyodonews.net/list/news/election): Election news and political coverage of Japan's government and policy

## Japan-US Relations & Diplomacy

- [Japan PM Willing to Help Ensure Hormuz Safety](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/72649): News article on Japan-US relations regarding Strait of Hormuz security
- [Iran War Complicates Japan's Indo-Pacific Focus](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/72694): Analysis of Japan-US diplomatic strategy amid Iran conflict and China concerns
- [Japan and US Unveil $73 Billion Business Projects](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/72664): News on Japan-US joint business projects including nuclear reactor development
- [Trump Compares Iran War with Pearl Harbor](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/72647): News article on Trump's controversial Pearl Harbor comparison regarding Iran

- [Kabuki Actor's European Tour](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/72678): Feature on kabuki actor Nakamura Takanosuke's European cultural exchange tour
